description: MODIFIES THE FILESYSTEM. Apply a theme built in the Cronus UI Create Studio to the current project by running the version-pinned `cronus-ui theme add` CLI at the detected project root. It updates the app layout's theme attributes, writes the theme override block into the global stylesheet (replacing any previous one), and records the theme in cronus-ui.json. Use this when the user provides a Create Studio permalink or an exported theme JSON file and wants it applied. Set `dryRun` to preview the changes without writing anything.

dryRun.description: Preview what would change without writing any files.

source.description: The theme to apply: a Create Studio permalink URL, a bare `c=` payload, or a path to an exported theme JSON file.

name: apply_theme
title: Apply a Cronus UI theme to the project
